item.title: Tassel 1.3
item.description: Today now puts what to do first at the top, ranked by how soon it's due, how much it's worth and how long it takes, with the few messages that really need you. One To Do list with All, Today, Upcoming, Missing, Important and Done. AI summaries of messages, announcements and assignments, with time and effort estimates. One search that works on the page you're on. Grades shown out of 100 with what each assignment is worth. Join Canvas classes you're invited to, keep your accounts in sync between Macs, course links on each class's home page, videos that open in Tassel, a cleaner sidebar and bigger text. Also fixes sign-ins that could be lost overnight.

item.title: Tassel 1.2
item.description: Tassel is now free for everyone, with Tassel Pro for invited students. New: assignment types you can filter and sort, one layout for assignments and messages, optional on-device summaries with an Action Needed list, and a week-long Pro trial.

item.title: Tassel 1.1
item.description: Sign-in fixes for schools with their own login pages, Important items, a better menu bar panel, Settings → Classes, automatic updates.
